rows.question: Why did my card ask for a PIN after several tap payments?

If you prefer not to enter your PIN for tap payments, you can change it. Open **Cards**, select the card, choose **PIN**, and then **Change PIN**. Enter a new 4-digit PIN twice. rows.reply: NovaPay issues Visa and Mastercard debit cards. When both are available for your country, you can choose one when you order the card. The logo is printed on your physical card and shown in the app. To change network you need a replacement card, which costs £5. Support will help with the rest.

rows.question: List all the fees for adding money.
rows.reply: To add money to your NovaPay account, you can use cash, cheques, or card top-ups. Cash deposits have a fee of 1.5% of the amount. For amounts above £1,000 in a month, there's an additional 0.5% fee. Card top-ups are usually the fastest, but they may have different fees and limits. Bank transfers are recommended for larger amounts. Each method has its own fees and limits.

rows.question: What fees apply at the weekend if I've used up my exchange allowance?
rows.reply: If you've used up your exchange allowance, a 1% weekend markup applies from Friday 22:00 to Sunday 22:00 UK time. This applies even if you've reached your monthly exchange limit. Additionally, if you've used up your monthly allowance, both the 1% weekend markup and the monthly exchange fee will apply.
